curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42072-1-1.pdf (one book: pull-back motor and rear axle steps 3-5, front lever steps 17-28, loose bonnet block step 53, functions page 49)

functions.does: The rear wheels turn together on the axle through the pull-back motor: pulled back along the ground they wind it up, and let go the motor drives the car forward.
functions.source: book: steps 3-5 (motor and rear axle), page 49 (right insets: pull back, let go)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely on their axle.
When the car runs into a wall, the lever sticking out low at the front is knocked back, and its upright arm flicks the loose bonnet block up off the car.
functions.source: book: page 49 (left inset: the bonnet flying off as the car hits; lower right inset: the car hitting the wall); front steps 17-28; how the lever reaches the block is inferred from the model
functions.note: The bonnet block (p125 88646, p128 3701, p133 2431 and the parts under them) only sits on the car by two pins (step 53) and is meant to fly off.

functions.does: The pull-back motor's spring drives the car once it is wound and let go.
functions.skip: a spring; only matters under force
